rubrics.title: Model Quality & Information Review Rubric
rubrics.acceptanceExpectation: The output is usable and technically coherent, evidence supports findings, and no critical QA/QC issue is left unexplained.

criteria.title: Model Structure & Information
criteria.description: Reviews structure, naming, levels/grids, parameters, and completeness.

criteria.title: Accuracy & Consistency
criteria.description: Identifies material inconsistencies and supports conclusions with evidence.

criteria.title: QA/QC Method
criteria.description: Uses a systematic, reproducible method and severity logic.

criteria.title: Findings & Technical Reasoning
criteria.description: Prioritises findings and proposes defensible corrective action.

criteria.title: Documentation Quality
criteria.description: Produces clear, traceable report/checklist evidence.

rubrics.title: Federated Coordination & Clash Review Rubric
rubrics.acceptanceExpectation: Federation assumptions are explicit, significant issues are correctly classified and traceable, and coordination actions are usable.

criteria.title: Federation & Setup
criteria.description: Verifies discipline scope, coordinates, units, alignment, and assumptions.

criteria.title: Clash Identification
criteria.description: Finds material issues without relying on unfiltered clash counts.

criteria.title: Issue Classification
criteria.description: Groups, prioritises, and assigns meaningful categories.

criteria.title: Coordination Reasoning
criteria.description: Proposes ownership, actions, and recheck logic with justification.

criteria.title: Report & Traceability
criteria.description: Links issue log, screenshots, status, and recommendations.

rubrics.title: 4D Model-Schedule Linkage Rubric
rubrics.acceptanceExpectation: WBS interpretation, common-ID rules, grouping, mapping, validation, and sequence reasoning are coherent and traceable.

criteria.title: WBS & Activity Understanding
criteria.description: Interprets IDs, dates, dependencies, scope, and intent correctly.

criteria.title: Model Breakdown
criteria.description: Defines usable grouping logic aligned with construction scope.

criteria.title: Common-ID Model-Schedule Mapping
criteria.description: Creates complete, traceable links and validates missing/duplicate/format cases.

criteria.title: Sequence Logic
criteria.description: Evaluates sequence states and identifies linkage/data issues.

criteria.title: Documentation
criteria.description: Explains assumptions, problems, corrections, and evidence clearly.

rubrics.title: QTO / 5D Validation Rubric
rubrics.acceptanceExpectation: Extraction and reconciliation are reproducible, discrepancies are reasoned, and no critical reliability concern is unresolved.

criteria.title: Model Readiness
criteria.description: Checks scope, categories, units, classification, and parameters.

criteria.title: Quantity Extraction
criteria.description: Produces a controlled and reproducible quantity extract.

criteria.title: Validation Method
criteria.description: Uses an appropriate comparison and reconciliation method.

criteria.title: Discrepancy Analysis
criteria.description: Explains differences, assumptions, and reliability risks.

criteria.title: Documentation
criteria.description: Presents methodology, tables, evidence, and limitations clearly.

rubrics.title: Automation / Digital Workflow Improvement Rubric v2
rubrics.acceptanceExpectation: The improvement is useful and repeatable, outputs are validated, benefits are measured, feedback is incorporated, and external release governance is traceable.

criteria.title: Problem & Baseline
criteria.description: Defines a material workflow problem, users, inputs, baseline, and success measure.

criteria.title: Information & Workflow Architecture
criteria.description: Defines coherent IDs, transformations, controls, and safe operating boundaries.

criteria.title: Functional Result & Validation
criteria.description: Demonstrates useful derived output and tests missing, duplicate, format, and failure cases.

criteria.title: Benchmark & Practical Benefit
criteria.description: Compares time, steps, errors, and repeatability against the baseline.

criteria.title: Feedback & Improvement Cycle
criteria.description: Records mentor/user feedback and a traceable revision response.

criteria.title: Safe Use, Governance & Handover
criteria.description: Documents limitations, SOP, external release identity, responsibility, and next action without uploading source or executables.

rubrics.title: BIM Documentation, Governance & Handover Rubric v2
rubrics.acceptanceExpectation: The package is structured, consistent, traceable, explicit about governance and limitations, usable for handover, and supported by closeout evidence.

criteria.title: Deliverable Structure
criteria.description: Organises scope, register fields, files, and status coherently.

criteria.title: Naming, Status & Authority
criteria.description: Applies naming, suitability/status, revision, and information-authority logic.

criteria.title: Issue Traceability & Consistency
criteria.description: Links revisions, issue states, decisions, model-derived outputs, drawings, and registers.

criteria.title: Workflow, SOP & Limitations
criteria.description: Documents use, inputs/outputs, validation, responsibilities, limitations, and external artifact references where applicable.

criteria.title: Handover & Knowledge Transfer
criteria.description: Provides a usable handover narrative, backlog, and knowledge-transfer evidence.

criteria.title: Presentation & Closeout
criteria.description: Communicates problem, method, result, limitations, next development, and mentor sign-off clearly.
